long_biography.plain_text:
Vieujot began creating companies after completing engineering and entrepreneurship studies in France, Britain and Germany. He founded Platre.com, acquired another technology business and joined André Martinie in buying Freelance.com, where he became chief executive. The staffing platform later entered the French public market, giving him experience in acquisitions, corporate restructuring and listings.

After moving to Dubai, he established Eiffel Management and used experience with a French listed property company to develop a regional investment platform. In 2010, that business and Dubai Islamic Bank launched Emirates REIT, the first Sharia-compliant trust incorporated in the DIFC. At Enata, Vieujot applied advanced composites and engineering to marine, aerospace and architectural projects.
